newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ANZ/Postbank cut NZ floating mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: ANZ/Postbank cut NZ floating mortgage rates.

text.p: ANZ Bank and Postbank said on Wednesday they would cut their variable mortgage lending rates to 9.95 percent from 10.65 percent.
ANZ said it was also cutting its index lending rate to 10.95 percent from 11.75 percent.
ANZ's farm lending rate was cut to 10.6 percent from 11.4 percent.
ANZ and Postbank's one year fixed mortgage rate will fall to 9.5 percent from 9.95 percent.
The three-year fixed rate remains at 8.95 percent.
Retail Banking General Manager Kathryn Fagg said the rate cuts were in response to lower wholesale rates.
